SALARY: $26 per hour + housing & travel stipends based on eligibility

LOCATION: St. Louis Headquarters

ANTICIPATED START: Summer 2027

COMPANY:

We are home to the nation’s most iconic beer and beyond beer brands, including Michelob ULTRA – America’s #1 top-selling beer – as well as Busch Light, Budweiser, Bud Light, Stella Artois, Cutwater Spirits, and industry-leading craft brands. From our longstanding efforts to support American farmers, military, veterans, and first responders, to emergency drinking water donations and responsible drinking programs, we are guided by our commitment to the communities we call home and the 65,000 hardworking Americans who bring our beer to life. We are powered by a team that shares our passion to create a future with more cheers. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?

ROLE SUMMARY:

At Anheuser-Busch, technology is a critical enabler of growth, efficiency, and innovation across one of the world's most iconic consumer products companies.

Our mission is to efficiently digitize and monetize our ecosystem. We unlock value through data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and a strong digital core that drives operational excellence, enables continuous improvement, and fuels reinvestment into the business.

The Technology Internship Program provides students with meaningful, hands-on experience while building the foundational skills needed for a successful career in technology. Interns are placed in one of several technology role areas based on business needs, technical interests, skills, and development opportunities, where they contribute to real business initiatives, learn from experienced professionals, and gain exposure to key technology and business challenges across Anheuser-Busch.

Most importantly, we're looking for students who are excited to build a long-term career with Anheuser-Busch and transition into our Technology Trainee Program after graduation, where they will continue developing into the next generation of Technology leaders.

TECHNOLOGY ROLE TYPES:

Engineering

Engineering interns help design, build, test, and improve technology solutions that support our business. Successful candidates demonstrate foundational software development and technical problem-solving skills, curiosity for emerging technologies and AI-enabled engineering practices, coursework or project experience related to application development, and a continuous learning mindset that enables them to grow in a rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Data & Analytics

Data & Analytics interns help transform enterprise data into trusted, actionable business insights by supporting data management, reporting, analytics, and decision-making activities. Successful candidates demonstrate strong analytical and quantitative thinking, attention to detail, the ability to identify patterns and opportunities within data, effective communication skills, and curiosity about how data drives business performance and value creation.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity interns help protect company systems, operations, and information assets through activities such as security monitoring, risk analysis, security controls, automation, and incident support. Successful candidates demonstrate an interest in cybersecurity concepts and technologies, an investigative and analytical mindset, structured problem-solving skills, personal accountability, and the ability to learn and apply technical concepts in a collaborative environment.

Infrastructure

Infrastructure interns help support the platforms and environments that keep technology operating securely, reliably, and efficiently across the business. Successful candidates demonstrate interest in cloud, networking, and infrastructure technologies, foundational technical and troubleshooting skills, a customer-focused mindset, curiosity for automation and continuous improvement, and the ability to learn and adapt in dynamic environments.

FOUNDATIONAL TECHNOLOGY CAPABILITIES:

Regardless of role type, all Technology Interns are expected to demonstrate the core capabilities that define success within Technology at Anheuser-Busch.

- AI-Enabled: Uses AI responsibly to improve speed, quality, productivity, and decision-making. Demonstrates curiosity and a willingness to leverage emerging technologies to continuously improve work.

- Business Driven: Connects day-to-day work to business outcomes and customer value. Understands how technology supports growth, operational excellence, and competitive advantage.

- Critical Thinking & Problem Solving: Applies structured thinking to solve complex challenges. Demonstrates sound judgment, root-cause analysis, and the ability to navigate ambiguity.

- Data Driven: Uses facts, data, and evidence to make decisions, identify opportunities, and measure results. Can communicate insights through clear and effective storytelling.

- Risk Ownership: Recognizes that security, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence are everyone's responsibility. Demonstrates accountability for identifying and managing risk.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business and technology initiatives

- Contribute to the design, development, implementation, operation, or support of technology solutions

- Analyze data and information to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for improvement

- Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to improve efficiency, quality, and productivity

- Participate in testing, troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous improvement activities

- Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Learn and apply Technology standards, processes, methodologies, and best practices

- Support secure, reliable, and compliant technology operations

- Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning

- Build knowledge of Anheuser-Busch's business, operations, customers, and technology ecosystem

- Complete meaningful project work and present recommendations, insights, or outcomes to Technology leaders and teams

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

- Current university student pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Analytics, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Demonstrated leadership, initiative, or involvement through coursework, academic projects, student organizations, internships, research, or extracurricular activities

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment

- Curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to learn

- Interest in technology, innovation, automation, data, AI, and digital transformation

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment

- Experience with technical coursework, projects, programming languages, analytical tools, or technologies relevant to the role area

- Passion for exploring career opportunities within Technology

WHY ANHEUSER-BUSCH:
At Anheuser-Busch, our purpose is to create a future with more cheers. For more than 165 years as a leading American manufacturer, Anheuser-Busch has delivered a legacy of brewing great-tasting, high-quality beers that have satisfied beer drinkers for generations. As the nation’s top brewer, one of the fastest growing spirits companies, and an insurgent force in energy drinks, we drive economic prosperity nationwide through investments in our people, facilities, and communities. We are the only alcohol company that invests in the U.S. at this scale.

Business Unit/Role Specific Information

In U.S. Consumer Services (USCS), our product is Membership—delivering benefits and services that are essential to our Card Members across travel, dining, entertainment, and retail. We compete by providing a differentiated Membership experience that drives loyalty and long-term growth. USCS brings this to life through our premium, cobrand, cash back, and lending portfolios, Membership Rewards, Travel & Lifestyle Services, the Centurion Lounge network, Global Dining, U.S. Consumer Banking, Amex Offers, Amex Ads, and best-in-class marketing programs.

Responsibilities

How will you make an impact in this role?

We are looking for a Summer Product Development Graduate intern to support the team on critical and innovative projects. The summer intern will own a project contributing to either the launch or evolution of our card, lending, or membership (I.e. travel, dining, etc.) services products.

This person will contribute to product vision, strategy, and delivery of our digital products and gain invaluable experience.

Product Managers at American Express play a central role identifying customer needs, building outstanding experiences, and leading teams across the company to launch these products. This is a fast-paced team driving the development of card member solutions and partner experiences at American Express.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree program specializing in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Product Management, Systems Engineering or related field.
- 2+ years of professional work experience in product management, product development, strategy, consulting, customer insights, or a related business function.
- Master’s degree candidates with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.

Preferred Qualifications

- Proven interest in card, lend or membership focused products (I.e. travel, dining, etc.).
- Accountability for the end-to-end experience, immersed in the customer experience and performance metrics.
- Natural problem-solver who is organized, has great attention to detail & can multi-task while considering the big picture
- Phenomenal team player who is naturally curious about how things work, flexible, and comfortable with ambiguity.
- Consistently seeks feedback from a diverse group of colleagues and partners, demonstrating clear actions taken to respond.
- Entrepreneurial thinker who’s organized, have great attention to detail, and can multi-task.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving/quantitative skills.
- Willing to take risks, experiment, and share fresh perspectives.
- Proficient in analytical and presentation tools, including Excel and PowerPoint.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and ability to present ideas clearly.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

About the company

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About the organization

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

- Competitive base salaries

- Flexible work arrangements and schedules with hybrid and virtual options with Amex Flex

- Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)

- Free and confidential counselling support through our Healthy Minds program

- Career development and training opportunities

For a full list of Team Amex benefits, visit out Colleague Benefits Site.

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. American Express will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. For positions covered by federal and/or state banking regulations, American Express will comply with such regulations as it relates to the consideration of applicants with criminal convictions.

We back our colleagues with the support they need to thrive, professionally and personally. That's why we have Amex Flex, our enterprise working model that provides greater flexibility to colleagues while ensuring we preserve the important aspects of our unique in-person culture. Depending on role and business needs, colleagues will either work onsite, in a hybrid model (combination of in-office and virtual days) or fully virtually.

University - 2027 Summer Games Software Developer Intern - El Segundo, CA

The Opportunity:

The Summer Games is an innovative internship program that attracts some of the nation’s best and brightest students. The goal is to develop a breakthrough idea or solution for one of our customer's most pressing, complex, and multidimensional problems while developing valuable technical skills. This competitive and collaborative program attracts thousands of applicants each year. Simulating a real-world startup accelerator environment, the interns are divided into teams, each working on a different challenge project. Throughout the Games, interns receive mentorship from senior leaders, solve problems using Booz Allen’s products and unique engagement models, and leverage the power of collaboration in a team environment.

The summer culminates with a final Challenge Cup competition and presentation to senior leadership. A past winner took the challenge of helping blind individuals navigate by using new technology and developing a business and market penetration plan. Teams have also helped to develop an app that gives military commanders an easy way to track real-time and open-source information about developing situations, including sudden attacks, fighting human trafficking, and even tracking the spread of a disease worldwide.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

- Experience with programming languages, including Java, JavaScript, C, C++, Assembly, Python, Perl, R, or Bash

- Experience with machine learning, data mining, statistics, or graph algorithms in academic or internship environments

- Experience with conducting research and writing software

- Ability to produce technical documentation and create design artifacts

- Ability to work independently and in teams

- Ability to obtain a Secret clearance

- Scheduled to obtain a Bachelor’s degree in a Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics field by Summer 2028 or Summer 2029

Nice If You Have:

- Ability to produce technical documentation and create design artifacts

- Possession of excellent critical thinking and analytical skills

- Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $53,000.00 to $108,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

- Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

- Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.

- Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Job Summary

The Quality Engineer Co‑op role is a temporary, experiential learning position designed to provide students with hands‑on, practical work experience related to their field of study. Co‑op participants contribute to meaningful projects and day‑to‑day business activities while developing professional skills, technical knowledge, and an understanding of real‑world organizational operations.

Job Description

Role Overview
The Co‑op position supports assigned teams, projects, and operational activities within the quality department. Responsibilities are tailored to the student’s academic background, skills, and learning objectives. Co‑ops are expected to apply classroom knowledge to practical assignments, follow established procedures, and collaborate effectively with team members.

This role operates under close supervision and may rotate through different tasks or projects depending on departmental needs and the duration of the assignment.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist with quality inspections, audits, and process evaluations.
- Collect, analyze, and report quality performance data.
- Support investigations of defects, nonconformances, and customer complaints.
- Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action activities.

- Assist in teardown of customer motor returns
- Maintain quality documentation, records, and procedures.
- Contribute to continuous improvement and Lean/Six Sigma initiatives.
- Prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations on quality metrics.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve product and process quality.
- Help ensure compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements.

Learning & Skill Development

Apply academic knowledge to real‑world business or technical challenges
Develop professional skills such as communication, time management, and teamwork
Learn organizational systems, tools, and processes relevant to the role

Data, Documentation & Reporting

Collect, organize, and analyze data as assigned
Prepare basic reports, presentations, or documentation
Maintain accurate records and follow documentation standards

Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with supervisors, mentors, and team members
Participate in meetings, training sessions, and reviews
Communicate progress, challenges, and results clearly and professionally

Safety, Compliance & Professional Conduct

Follow all company policies, safety requirements, and confidentiality standards
Adhere to ethical and professional workplace expectations
Complete required training and onboarding activities

Qualifications
Education & Eligibility

Currently enrolled in an accredited college or university
Pursuing a degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Business, Finance, IT, Supply Chain, HR, Marketing, Manufacturing, or related discipline)
Eligibility for cooperative education participation through academic institution

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong interest in gaining practical work experience
Ability to learn quickly and follow instructions
Basic analytical, technical, or administrative skills appropriate to field of study
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Assignment Details

Assignment length and schedule vary by department and academic program
Work may be full‑time or part‑time depending on program structure
Specific duties, learning objectives, and deliverables defined at assignment start
